subject: Top 5 supplement trends (2–6 Nov): Collagen, GLP-1 + 3 more
preview: The top trend from each weekday, 2 Nov – 6 Nov 2026, with links to the original articles. Free, every Monday.

trends.label: Collagen
trends.angle: Collagen is shifting from plain powders to blends, drinks and gummies, and source (marine or bovine) is a key choice on pack.
trends.why: 3 stories from 3 publishers in the three days to Mon 2 Nov: steady coverage that kept it near the top of the day's ranking.

trends.label: GLP-1 (and 'GLP-1 support')
trends.angle: Weight-loss drug news keeps spilling into supplements; 'GLP-1 support' wording draws regulator attention, so stick to claims you can back and are allowed to make.
trends.why: 4 stories from 4 publishers in the three days to Tue 3 Nov: about 1.7× its usual pace.

trends.label: Gut health
trends.angle: Gut health is a broad umbrella; brands are narrowing in on a specific occasion or user to stand out.
trends.why: 6 stories from 6 publishers in the three days to Wed 4 Nov: about 2.7× its usual pace.

trends.why: 10 stories from 10 publishers in the three days to Thu 5 Nov: about 2.5× its usual pace.
